author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನೀಚಾತಿ ನೀಚನವ ಸಂಸ್ಕಾರ ರಹಿತನಿರೆ
ಗೀಚುವನು ಜನಮನದಿ ಹೀನ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯ
ಯೋಚಿಸುತ ಯೋಜಿಸಿರೆ ಸಂಸ್ಕಾರ ಪಸರಿಸಲು
ಸೂಚಿಯದೆ ಸುಖಕದುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The lowest of the low is one without culture;
he scribbles base words and deeds into people’s minds;
if you think and plan to spread good upbringing,
that is the pointer to happiness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A person without culture spreads coarse words and deeds. Thoughtfully spreading good values (saṃskāra) is the way to a happy society.
